tiers.molecular_convergence: at least five natural systems converge on anthocyanin/flavonoid network nodes
tiers.environmental_access: Moricandia thermal treatment accesses overlapping network nodes and suppresses cyanidin

within_species_decoupling.tissue_boundary: PAL retains extra-floral anthocyanin while WAL lacks it broadly; flavones remain present in both

working_mechanism: many-to-one pigment-network accessibility plus floral/branch-specific decoupling as a persistence filter
claim_ceiling: strong within-species and literature-comparative support that petal-restricted anthocyanin loss can persist at much higher natural frequency than whole-plant anthocyanin loss; not yet a family-aware molecular architecture versus pleiotropic-cost test
hard_nonclaims: does not prove tissue restriction alone causes persistence
does not rescue failed BIO5 replication
does not establish repeated nonwhite-to-white evolutionary direction
